title: Acronym Generator
story: NASA. SCUBA. LASER. RADAR. These aren't just words — they're acronyms: National Aeronautics and Space Administration. Self-Contained Underwater Breathing Apparatus. Build a program that takes ANY phrase and extracts its acronym.
why: Acronym generation teaches extracting first letters, handling word boundaries, and filtering out noise words — practical string processing patterns.
analogy: A book's index takes the first letter of each topic to create quick-reference entries. Your acronym generator is the indexer: scan the phrase, grab the first letter of each significant word, capitalize, and assemble. Skip the filler words — they're just noise.
try_it: Add more skip words: 'to', 'an', 'by', 'on', 'at'. Handle hyphenated words by splitting on '-' too. Convert the acronym to all uppercase. Generate acronyms for famous organizations: FBI, CIA, UNESCO, INTERPOL.
tips: Extract first letter of each word AFTER filtering skip words
Convert to uppercase for standard acronym format
Handle the last word after the loop ends (no trailing space to trigger extraction)
common_mistakes: Including skip words like 'and', 'of', 'the' — most acronyms skip these
Forgetting to convert to uppercase — acronyms are capitalized by convention
Missing the last word — it has no trailing space to trigger extraction
